Explain why some Christians might prefer the symbol of the cross to the symbol of the
crucifix.

‘The life of Jesus is more important than his death.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
‘For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in
him shall not perish but have eternal life.’
John 3:16

Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

in the name of Allah.’
